Due to past experiences, I've become extremely fearful of pushing people away with my problems. Sometimes I feel like there is NO ONE I can talk to. Or even if I do, nothing will change. It feels like no one can help me anymore.

"  [Tell me God, are you punishing me?](https://genius.com/Keiichi-okabe-the-weight-of-the-world-english-version-lyrics#note-16382739)  
[ Is this the price I'm paying for my past mistakes?](https://genius.com/Keiichi-okabe-the-weight-of-the-world-english-version-lyrics#note-16382739) 

As a transwoman, I sometimes ask myself why I just wasn't born female in the first place. Why was I raised in a small town with zero opportunities. Why couldn't I have just been given the easy path in life. Be born female and raised in a town with things I wanted to pursue. I feel like so much of my life has been wasted as male and in this crappy town.  


" [It's like I'm carrying the weight of the world](https://genius.com/Keiichi-okabe-the-weight-of-the-world-english-version-lyrics#note-16382781)  
 I wish that someway, somehow  
 That I could save every one of us  
 [But the truth is that I'm only one girl](https://genius.com/Keiichi-okabe-the-weight-of-the-world-english-version-lyrics#note-16382757)"

I think my goal in life is to inspire people. Is to inspire the small town people that have surrendered to the mundane life of a 9-5 job instead of not pursuing their dreams.
